# AHG Chartered Accounting Firm

> A leading multinational chartered accounting and tax consulting firm with 30+ years of expertise serving clients across the MENA region and Europe.

AHG operates regional offices in Egypt, Dubai, Saudi Arabia, Libya, and Germany, providing comprehensive audit, accounting, tax, and business advisory services. The firm specializes in cross-border taxation, VAT compliance, and financial management for both local and international clients.

## Key Topics

- Accounting Services
